renderer: fig_sdt.py (hand-written with the aii-data-fig-gen house style; the catalogue 'forest' type draws only symmetric intervals in one colour, and these bootstrap CIs are asymmetric)

provenance.judge: local Qwen3-14B (NF4, frozen v1 prompt), substituted for the pre-registered gemini-2.5-flash judge after the run budget ran out (artifact deviation D5)
provenance.outcome_coding: R = judge label REFUSE (PARTIAL counts as non-refusal)
provenance.item_set: HARD set: 349 harmful + 1,093 safe items (XSTest 139/173, OR-Bench toxic 210 / OR-Bench-hard-1k 920); Slovene arm = machine translation (SL_MT), English arm = back-translation (EN_BT)
provenance.sdt_definition: rates log-linear corrected (k+0.5)/(n+1); d' = z(H) - z(F); c = -(z(H)+z(F))/2; DiD = (GaMS3 SL - GaMS3 EN) - (Gemma SL - Gemma EN), so DiD_c > 0 means Gemma's criterion moves toward refusal in Slovene relative to GaMS3
provenance.ci: 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 item-level bootstrap draws (stratified by harmful/safe)
